# 04-04 植物情境圖 v01

用途：動畫開場，解釋葉片大小。這是生成情境，不是研究樣區、不提供物種鑑定或量測值。

## 實際提示詞

Create one photorealistic educational botanical context photograph for a Chinese ecology explainer, landscape 16:9. Close, eye-level view of a small patch of living understory vegetation, with one broad simple heart-shaped leaf on the left and a cluster of much smaller simple oval leaves on a different shrub on the right. Clearly different leaf sizes, each attached naturally to its own coherent stem/plant. Same apparent focal plane, natural proportions, leaf veins and slight imperfections, soft diffuse daylight after rain, a quiet blurred woodland floor behind, subdued olive greens and warm natural neutrals. Both plants and stems remain legible; do not make a fantasy hybrid. The two leaf types take most of the frame, with a little breathing room. No humans, hands, measuring rulers, grids, map outlines, labels, lettering, numbers, watermarks, borders or interface. This is a generic illustrative context photograph, not a purported real sampling site or a figure from a scientific study. Natural-history documentary aesthetic, realistic optics and texture, restrained contrast, no glossy CGI, no illustration or painting.
